items.best_pick_reason: Electronics are client-supplied, so the pick only needs to anchor the dimensioned drawings and give a realistic price line. The Samsung UA65DU8100KXXT is the best choice: a mainstream mid-range Crystal UHD whose real without-stand footprint (1451 x 832 mm) is the closest clean fit to the 1400 x 800 target (~+3.6% W, +4% H — inside +/-15%), from the highest-volume brand in Thai retail (Power Buy / Thai Watsadu / HomePro all stock it) at a middle-of-market ~19,990 THB. All six 65in candidates share nearly the same 1445-1454 x 831-838 panel footprint, so the drawing is robust regardless of which model the client actually brings; the DU8100 simply represents the median case. Note for the drawing: real panels are only 26-64mm thick — the 80mm target depth should be read as a wall-mount standoff allowance (budget ~40-100mm for the bracket), not the panel itself.
